collectionMetadata.name: The Living Index: Specimen Archive No. 04
collectionMetadata.description: A curated repository of 20th-century avant-garde typography, structural constructivism, and tectonic abstractions. Catalogued directly from independent private archives under an open scholarly ledger.
collectionMetadata.curatorialStatement: Every archival specimen preserved herein represents a deliberate departure from decorative historicism towards raw tectonic autonomy. We present these objects without theatrical ornament, honoring their physical medium, scale, and provenance.

items.title: Composition in Spatial Tension (Study VIII)
items.medium: Oil and graphite on unprimed Belgian linen
items.provenanceText: Acquired directly from the artist's Weimar studio by Dr. Heinrich Voss, 1928; thence by descent to Voss Galerie, Zurich; private collection, Paris, 1974; bequest to The Living Index Foundation, 2019.

items.title: Study of Shadow and Linear Tectonics
items.medium: Gelatin silver print mounted on heavy rag board
items.provenanceText: Printed under the supervision of the artist, Berlin; confiscated during 1937 Entartete Kunst purge; recovered from storage in Munich, 1946; acquired by Maurice & Claire Danvers, Geneva, 1961.

items.title: Nocturne with Ochre and Iron Oxide
items.medium: Distemper and dry pigment on weathered timber panel
items.provenanceText: Studio of the artist, Saint-Paul-de-Vence; Galerie Pierre Loeb, Paris, 1952; Collection of Sir Kenneth Clark, London; Christie's London, June 1989, Lot 44; Private Archive, Montreal.

items.title: Modular Rhythm in Red and Cadmium Orange
items.medium: Screenprint on heavy wove Arches paper, trial proof
items.provenanceText: Edition printed by Atelier 17, Paris; gift from the master printer to Suzanne Valadier; acquired at Hôtel Drouot, 1993; gift of the Curatorial Circle to The Living Index, 2021.
items.rightsStatement: Estate of the Artist / Index Reproduction Permit

items.title: Monolith in Repose: Density Analysis
items.medium: Cast patinated bronze with cold-rolled steel base
items.provenanceText: Commissioned for the Olivetti Executive Pavilion, Ivrea; preserved in corporate archive until 1982; Fondazione Nuove Forme, Turin; acquired through reciprocal exchange, 2017.

items.title: Cartography of Silence (Variant IV)
items.medium: Handmade washi paper, sumi ink, and burnished silver leaf
items.provenanceText: Created during the artist's residency in Kyoto; exhibited at Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum, 1973; collection of T. Nakamura; acquired by The Living Index in 2023.

items.title: Chromatic Lattice with Micro-Interference
items.medium: Acrylic and vinyl emulsion on hardboard
items.provenanceText: Exhibited at Salon des Réalités Nouvelles, Paris; collection of Pierre & Marthe Garnier; acquired through public auction, London, 2004.

items.title: Tectonic Palimpsest (Industrial Fragment)
items.medium: Reclaimed oxidized copper, beeswax, and linen twine
items.provenanceText: Studio of the artist, Glasgow; exhibited at Fruitmarket Gallery, Edinburgh, 1997; private collection, Berlin; donated in memory of Dr. Alistair MacLeod, 2022.
